plain: Badge is 2px taller (22px), its label sits 1px higher and its corner is a step under the action radius (6px by default); re-take screenshots and check fixed-height rows that hold badges.

steps.plain: --component-badge-height is now 22px (was 20px); check fixed-height rows that hold badges.
--component-badge-minWidth is now 22px (was 20px), so a one-digit count badge is 2px wider.
--component-badge-radius is now a fixed 6px (was the action radius); Badge itself renders role.radius minus 2px, so read that instead if you matched its corner.
Pages themed with the soft-demo brand (data-brand="soft-demo") may look different (badge radius, and --semantic-space-component-padding no longer overridden), so check them after upgrading.
